claims.claim: Node object page lists XML id as UINT16
DTD id values are CDATA XML attributes, with no id on CDXML root
colortable and fonttable carry kCDXProp constants, not object constants
color, font, and s inventory entries have no CDX constant or numeric ID

contradictions.resolution: Keep object, property, and XML-only namespaces distinct; these rows do not supply binary object IDs for the XML tags.

sdk_mapping.detail_status: AllCDXObjects links Arrow.htm, but the archived page returned 404.

generic_object_id.id_resolution_statement: IDs should be unique within a CDX/CDXML file; if ambiguous, the reference resolves to the closest object with that ID.

id_semantics.interpretation: Preserve the object-page id property type and generic CDXObjectID reference type as separate source claims; the sources do not explain whether their UINT16/UINT32 difference is historical object-ID storage versus reference width.

limitations: A missing exact SDK row is not proof that an XML feature is invalid or unsupported.
SDK page properties are joined only by exact owner XML name and exact CDXML Name; no alias or semantic type is inferred.
reference_target remains null unless an explicit type or direct statement supplies it; targets are not inferred from attribute names.
SDK enum ordinals are not synthesized from DTD lexical enumeration tokens.

retrieval.method: explicit development acquisition against Internet Archive Mementos
retrieval.raw_html_policy: raw SDK HTML is hashed and parsed in memory, not copied to the repository

schema_anomalies.dtd_content_model: <!ELEMENT altgroup (objecttag | annotation | t | fragment | group | graphic | bracket)+>

source.locator: Properties table: rows 56 and 59 both report 0x0A38

cross_check.note: The archived global property table repeats both assignments; it is part of the same SDK source family, not independent confirmation. The linked detailed property pages were unavailable.
